name: Unicommerce Esolutions Ltd
title: Unicommerce Esolutions Ltd - 544227 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 14.3% to INR51.4 cr but adjusted EBITDA down 14.5% to INR8.1 cr as management front-loads growth spend; no supply-side or capacity signals since it is a software business.

triggers.label: Uniware growth 15%+ from Q4 FY27
triggers.quote: we are confident of delivering growth of over 15% from quarter 4 FY '27 onwards in Uniware

triggers.label: Shipway growth 20%+ from Q4 FY27
triggers.quote: we would be able to drive 20% plus growth year-on-year by the end of the year, that is quarter 4 FY '27 onwards

triggers.label: Enterprise customer adds up 30.7%
triggers.quote: we added 115 enterprise customers, up 30.7% compared to 88 in the same quarter last year

triggers.label: Adj. EBITDA down 14.5% on investment
triggers.quote: Adjusted EBITDA for the quarter was INR8.1 crores, 14.5% lower compared to INR9.5 crores

guidance.quote: we are confident of delivering growth of over 15% from quarter 4 FY '27 onwards in Uniware
we would be able to drive 20% plus growth year-on-year by the end of the year, that is quarter 4 FY '27 onwards
We are targeting to make Shipway breakeven in quarter 3 itself

guidance.value: INR2.5-4 crores per quarter over next year
guidance.quote: the spend would be trending in the similar range of INR2.5 crores to INR4 crores per quarter

red_flags.label: Adj. EBITDA down 14.5% YoY; PAT up on tax benefit
red_flags.quote: The increase in PAT is due to tax benefits recognized during the quarter.

red_flags.label: Top 10 customer exit; top-10 growth tied to market
red_flags.quote: top 10 customers by virtue of their size, their growth is broadly reflective of the market growth

red_flags.label: Shipway sales flat near INR20 cr for several quarters; competitor winning big clients
red_flags.quote: we are a relatively early-stage player, single-digit market share today

evasions.quote: It will be hard for us to tell the number right now
On the competitive intensity, we continue to be a market leader on the Uniware side.
